title: Nightshift
enableHint: Applies immediately, then checks every minute. Overrides manual profile changes while enabled.
disabledHint: Scheduling is off. Disabling leaves the current profile unchanged. Runs only while the Omarchy shell is running.
invalidConfig: Invalid saved configuration. Scheduling is off; save a valid schedule to repair it.
invalidSchedule: Enter two different times in HH:mm format (00:00–23:59).
unavailableProfile: Performance profile is not available on this hardware. Choose another profile.
loadFailed: Could not read the saved schedule.
saveFailed: Could not save the schedule. The previous schedule remains active.
readFailed: Could not read the power profile. Check power-profiles-daemon.
applyFailed: Could not apply the power profile. Check the daemon and your session permissions.
